main.description: One organizer-defined attendee-facing program within an event, such as the main schedule or workshops.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this program record was created.

description.description: A public description of this attendee-facing program.

event.description: The DID-based record URI of the events.openmusic.event containing this program.

eventPlaces.description: The exhaustive list of places used by this program, in organizer-defined lane order. An empty list means the program contains only unplaced items.

icon.description: A platform-neutral icon for this program's tab or section.

title.description: The attendee-facing title used for this program's tab or section.
